title: strategic-1on1-prep-and-flagged-decision-tasks
content:
Purpose: prep notes for 1:1 with CEO (20m) + quick sync on exec-staff follow-ups (10m). Use as talking bullets and quick decision index.

Top objectives for this 1:1:
- Align on immediate customer-impact priorities (Dedicated renewal + Private pilot)
- Surface operational risk from yesterday's region blip (SFO GPU fleet latency spike)
- Confirm roll-forward plan for rollout gating criteria (metrics + safety)
- Get signoff for headcount reallocation request (SRE -> infra ops temporary)

Key context (TL;DR):
- Dedicated renewal: Big mid-market customer (FinOpsApp) on month-to-month; risk of churn if P99 latency >250ms for >48h. Renewal negotiation starts next week. Sales shared price-flex floor Wednesday.
- Private pilot: EU-regulated customer (healthcare) onboarding delayed by KMS integrations. Security signoff pending but on-track for pilot in 3 weeks if we approve dedicated engineering slot.
- Region incident (2026-03-11): short (~2.5h) elevated tail latency on SFO; root cause probable kernel regression in custom attention kernel after rolling a micro-optimization. Primary mitigation: rollback to previous kernel for affected pools plus temporary traffic reroute. Postmortem draft linked.

Talking bullets (start with headline then 1–2 sentences):
1) "Customer churn risk — FinOpsApp renewal": they expect predictable P99; ops mitigations in place but want expedited SLA offer. Ask: approve 2-week fast-track for capacity reservation and a temporary credit for tail events. Impact: reduces churn risk; cost ~2–3% ARR if exercised.
2) "Private pilot gating — KMS timeline": need greenlight to re-prioritize one infra engineer for 3 weeks to close KMS integration. Ask: allocate engineer Marcus Lee to pilot. Tradeoff: delays infra backlog items A and B ~2 sprints.
3) "SFO latency tail — roll & monitoring": rolled to previous kernel for affected pools; still need deploy of canary with additional telemetry. Ask: prioritize PR #3245 for canary within 48h.
4) "Headcount ask — temporary SRE support": propose moving two contractors from Platform Tools to SRE until mid-Q2 to stabilize post-incident monitoring. Ask: approval to reassign contractors and temporary budget reclassification.

Questions I expect / want to ask:
- "Do you want to approve the temporary SLA credit for FinOpsApp or try a technical-first approach (deeper KV caching + routing tweak)?"
- "Are you comfortable reallocating one infra engineer (Marcus) to the Private pilot at the cost of delaying infra backlog?"
- "Any red lines on using credits for retention vs. saving for net-new acquisition?"
- "Do we want to publicize the SFO incident internally (short note) or keep it limited to ops + affected customers?"

Back-of-envelope metrics to cite:
- Current platform P99 (global, last 7d): ~220ms; SFO spike pushed P99 to ~420ms between 03:10–05:40 PDT on 2026-03-11.
- FinOpsApp current committed monthly spend: ~$28k; estimated churn impact (loss of ARR if churned): ~336k/year.
- Cost of 2-week capacity reservation for their peak profile: ~$6k–$8k.

Open items / artifacts to pull in during meeting:
- Postmortem draft (confluence://pages/infra-incidents-2026q1)
- Kernel rollback changelog + PRs (github PR #3245)
- FinOpsApp account notes (JIRA-4221)
- Pilot onboarding checklist (confluence://pages/private-pilot-checklist)
